wave3.scope: card 02 (ga'al / padah / pidyon): MT morphology for 16 loci plus context Num 18:17; LXX two mirrors per locus (third for Exod 13:13 and Isa 63:9); NT lemma search; BDB and LSJ glosses
resultsSummary: Exod 13:13: MT clause 'break its neck' (c/6202, HC/Vqq2ms/Sp3ms) has no Greek counterpart in three mirrors (Sollupulo, eliranwong, Studylight); Greek reads 'exchange with a sheep; if not exchanged, ransom it'; LOCATOR_HOLD (Swete 1887 apparatus and Göttingen Exodus not checked).
Kinsman ga'al (Lev 25:25-26; Ruth 4:4-6; Num 35:19): LXX splits role (ἀγχιστ-) from act (λυτρόομαι in Lev 25); Num 35:19 go'el ha-dam kills the murderer (ἀποκτενεῖ).
Padah of unclean animals: ἀλλάξει / ἀλλάξεις (exchange) in Lev 27:27 and Exod 13:13 (first clause) but λυτρώσῃ in Num 18:15; clean firstborn not redeemed (Num 18:17: holy; blood on the altar).
Num 3:46 and 3:49 use lemma 6302 (ransom), not 6299; 3:49 pidyom = 6306; LXX λύτρα / ἐκλύτρωσις.

Divine ga'al: λυτρόομαι (Exod 6:6; Isa 63:9); Isa 59:20 MT go'el = LXX ὁ ῥυόμενος = NT Rom 11:26 quotation (LXX-like). Isa 63:9 LXX: 'not an envoy nor an angel, but the Lord himself' (MT: 'angel of his presence').

NT lemma counts (MorphGNT): λυτρόομαι 3; λύτρωσις 3; ἀπολύτρωσις 10; λυτρωτής 1; ἐξαγοράζω 4; ἀγχιστ- 0; ῥύομαι 15. 1 Pe 1:18 denies silver and gold as price; Heb 9:15 redemption from transgressions 'by death' (NT interpretation).
Transcription errors: Sollupulo Ruth 4:6 (διαφείρω, ἀχγιστείαν); eliranwong Ruth 4:4 duplicate phrase (extraction artifact).

wave4.scope: card 03 (asham / hattat / avon / pesha / maʿal / šᵉgāgâ): MT morphology for 24 loci; LXX mirrors (Sollupulo, eliranwong, lxx-swete) with numbering check for Lev 6–7; NT quotation and lemma checks (Heb 10:5–8; Rom 4:7–8); BDB and LSJ glosses
resultsSummary: Asham in Lev 5–6, Num 5 and Num 18 is rendered πλημμέλεια / πλημμελέω / κριὸς τῆς πλημμελίας (trespass offering); hattat as ἁμαρτία / περὶ ἁμαρτίας. Exceptions: Lev 5:7 (asham → περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας) and Isa 53:10 (asham → περὶ ἁμαρτίας).
LXX numbering: Lev 6:1–7 = MT 5:20–26; 6:17 = MT 6:10; 6:31–37 = MT 7:1–7; 7:1 = MT 7:11. The guilt law is present in LXX, not omitted (LOCATOR resolved).

'Bear iniquity' (nasa' avon): LXX ἀφαιρέω (Exod 34:7; Lev 10:17 ἀφέλητε), λαμβάνω (Lev 5:17; Ezek 18:20), ἀφίημι (Ps 31:5). Lev 10:17 'to bear the iniquity of the congregation' → 'that you remove the sin of the congregation'.

Restitution: Lev 5:16 and 6:5–6 (principal + fifth + ram; LXX ἀποτίσαι, τὸ ἐπίπεμπτον, κριὸς τῆς πλημμελίας). Num 5:7–8: restitution to the wronged person; if there is no go'el, to the priest (go'el → ἀγχιστεύων, see card 02).
Unwitting vs high hand: Num 15:27–29 (hattat, ἀκουσίως); Num 15:30–31 (defiant act, no sacrifice; LXX ἐξολεθρευθήσεται; 'her sin is upon her').

NT: Heb 10:5–8 quotes LXX Ps 39:7–9 with σῶμα (LXX mirrors agree) and εὐδόκησας for LXX ᾔτησας; Rom 4:7–8 is verbatim LXX Ps 31:1–2; ἔνοχος matches LXX Exod 34:7 lexically; 1 Pet 2:24 and Heb 9:28 point to Isa 53:12 (card 11).
Open: Hos 5:15 LXX ἀφανισθῶσιν vs MT ʾšm (EVIDENCE_HOLD); Ps 40:7 σῶμα vs MT 'ears' (EVIDENCE_HOLD); Isa 53:10 ἡμῶν / ὑμῶν (LOCATOR_HOLD).

wave5.scope: card 04 (dam / blood): 29 loci B1–B29 and controls K1–K3; MT lemmas and morphology (morphhb); LXX mirrors with word-level diff; numbering check Ps 51:16 = LXX 50:16; controls Lev 5:11, 16:16, 16:19, 16:27, 17:15, Num 35:33, Deut 21:4–6; NT: Heb 9:19–22, 10:4, 12:7–14, 13:12, 13:20; Acts 15:20, 15:29, 21:25, 20:28; Matt 26:28, Mark 14:24, Luke 22:19–20; 1 John 1:7, 2:2, 4:10; Rom 3:25; 1 Pet 1:2; Heb 11:28; John 6:53–56; Rev 7:14; Eph 2:13; Col 1:20; lemma counts; Strong, BDB and LSJ glosses
resultsSummary: MT: דָּם (1818) in 29 loci; lemmas and morphology checked against morphhb. LXX αἷμα in all loci except Gen 4:10 (number changed, plural → singular) and Exod 24:6 (verb shift "put" → "poured").
Deut 21:7 ketiv / qere: ketiv שפכה (3 fs) and qere שָׁפְכוּ (3 pl); LXX ἐξέχεαν (3 pl) follows the qere. EVIDENCE_HOLD.

Mirror discrepancies recorded: Gen 9:5 (FW omits ἀνθρώπου); Lev 16:14 (FW omits πρόσωπον); Lev 17:14 (SOL and FW πόσης vs ELI πάσης); Exod 12:7 (SOL and FW extra καὶ θμῶν); Exod 12:13 (FW ἐκτριφθῆναι). Other differences are transcription artefacts. LOCATOR_HOLD where mirrors disagree.
Numbering: Ps 51:16 (MT) = LXX 50:16 = ET 51:14; LXX Ps 50:18 = MT 51:18.
Counter-texts to "no forgiveness without blood" (Heb 9:22): Lev 5:11–13 (flour sin offering, no blood; control K3); Num 16:46–47 (incense; card 01).
Ritual without blood: Deut 21:1–9 (no sprinkling; LXX νευροκοπέω for MT "break the neck" in 21:4).

NT lemma counts (MorphGNT): αἷμα 97; ῥαντισμός 2; ῥαντίζω 4; αἱματεκχυσία 1; πνικτός 3; ἐκχέω 27; πρόσχυσις 1; ἱλαστήριον 2; ἱλασμός 2; λύτρωσις 3; ἀφαιρέω 10; ῥαίνω 0; ἐξιλάσκομαι 0; ἁγιάζω 28; καθαρίζω 31.
Lexicon: Strong H1818, H3722, H2236, H5137, H8210, H5355, H5315; BDB דם, זרק, נזה, שפך, נקי / נקה; LSJ αἷμα, ῥαντισμός, ῥαίνω, πνικτός; αἱματεκχυσία — no LSJ entry (Perseus).

Criterion 3 (classes a / b / c) recorded in card §6.3: (a) supports particular wording (Exod 24:8; Lev 16:15; Lev 17:11; Deut 21:8; Zech 9:11; Matt 26:28; Mark 14:24; Luke 22:20; Heb 13:12; Acts 20:28); (b) universal scope only in Gen 9:5–6 (not atonement) and Lev 17:10–13 (prohibition), universal atonement wording only in NT pointers (1 John 2:2; Col 1:20); (c) neutral loci listed.

H0 (blood as life given "instead of" life): identity of blood and life supported (R1); the substitution mechanism rests on the LXX ἀντί (Lev 17:11; Gen 9:6), not on the MT. Counter-readings R2–R5 recorded. EVIDENCE_HOLD; no verdict.
